native_mechanisms: Find all match positions at once by a single parallel same-symbol test over both sequences (the 'doubled shadow'), never scanning cell by cell
Compute the cost of the gap-only stretch between consecutive match positions arithmetically from the index differences on each sequence, never evaluating the intervening cells
At each match position keep only the best-scoring incoming tally per state (single displacement/'slip' already used or not) and prune every dominated tally
core_technique: Full O(n^2) Needleman-Wunsch DP evaluated in anti-diagonal (wavefront) order with three rolling diagonal buffers and one sequence reversed so each diagonal is a contiguous SIMD-vectorizable loop
